container: background-color: #f7f6f2; padding: 44px 16px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
h2: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: #2b2b28; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 4px; margin: 48px 0 28px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
h2_first: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: #2b2b28; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 4px; margin: 0 0 28px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
blockquote: background-color: #efede7; padding: 18px 22px; margin: 0 0 20px; color: #6e6a63; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85
pre: background-color: #efede7; border-left: 2px solid #d9d5cc; padding: 16px 18px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0 0 20px
code: color: #3d3a34; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #efede7; color: #3d3a34; padding: 2px 5px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
th: background-color: #efede7; color: #2b2b28; border: 1px solid #d9d5cc; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600
hr: height: 1px; width: 36px; border: none; background-color: #d9d5cc; margin: 48px auto
